{{Quote|Con'varra, the seedy Twi'lek who runs the office and performs the forgeries, offers fake identification documents, captain's accredited licenses, starship operating licenses, weapons load-out certificates and restricted goods transfer permits, as well as a host of other documents.|Platt Okeefe's description of Con'varra in a datafile|<ref name="PSG" />}}
'''Con'varra''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] from a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] who was sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] to the [[Slaver/Legends|enslaving]] lord [[Quintik Kahr]]. The Twi'lek was then handed to Quintik's [[Gender/Legends|brother]], [[Omze'kehr Kahr|Omze'kehr]], who freed him and had him trained in [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] and [[Forger (profession)/Legends|forgery]] so he could work aboard [[Omze's Incredible Traveling Starport/Legends|''Omze's Incredible Traveling Starport'']]. Con'varra ran an office on the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] named [[Con'varra's Datawork Central]], where he offered high-quality forgeries. He was mentioned in a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] complied by [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]] sometime before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. 

==Biography==
===Exiled, enslaved===
A [[City/Legends|city]] on<ref name="PSG" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] was home to the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] Con'varra before he was cast out and sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] as tribute to [[Quintik Kahr]], an enslaving lord known by the nickname "Big Quince." When Quintik's [[Gender/Legends|brother]], [[Omze'kehr Kahr|Omze'kehr]], began his mobile [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] named [[Omze's Incredible Traveling Starport/Legends|''Omze's Incredible Traveling Starport'']], the criminal handed over Con'varra as a good luck present to him. Omze'kehr freed the Twi'lek from [[Slaver/Legends|enslavement]] and paid large amounts of [[Currency/Legends|money]] having him trained by the finest [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] and [[Forger (profession)/Legends|forgery]] experts so he could use his new skills onboard the spaceport.<ref name="PSG" />

===Freed forger===
{{Quote|Prices for documents can run high, but the quality of forgeries is high. A typical forged starship document can run between 2,500 and 5,000 credits, depending on how soon the document is needed and how difficult it is to reproduce.|Platt Okeefe on Con'varra's forgeries|<ref name="PSG" />}}
[[File:OmzesIncredibleTravelingStarport-PlattsStarportGuide.jpg|thumb|right|325px|Con'varra worked aboard ''Omze's Incredible Traveling Starport'' (pictured).]]
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the aging Con'varra ran an office on the spaceport labeled [[Con'varra's Datawork Central]], which specialized in making datawork documents for [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]]. The Twi'lek was assisted by a large [[Computer/Legends|computer]] which correlated his forgeries with existing documents in the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] (BoSS). A secure section of his [[Computer/Legends|computer]] banks were reserved for keeping updates and copies of his forgeries and it was rumored that Omze'kehr reviewed them and occasionally sold information from the banks to interested parties.<ref name="PSG" />

The Twi'lek personally carried out the expensive but high-quality forgeries and also offered fake identification documents, [[Captain's Accredited License/Legends|Captain's Accredited Licenses]], [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] load-out certificates, and restricted good transfer permits. The average prices for these duties could range from 2,500 to 5,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], depending on the conditions. Con'varra did not, however, allow access to information in the BoSS databank or alter and modify [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder codes]] for [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. In the rare [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] the Twi'lek was not in performing work in his office, it was kept securely locked.<ref name="PSG" />

Before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="PSG" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Con'varra was mentioned in a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] compiled by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]], an infrequent visitor of the spaceport, to aid other smugglers and spacers. Okeefe used her notes on the people she met and borrowed entries from the [[Imperial Starport Registry]].<ref name="PSG" /> Con'varra was also mentioned as a contact in a [[SecuriDex]] file travelling advisory for the spaceport<ref name="P+P">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> produced by the [[Analysis (Alliance Intelligence)|Analysis]] department of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion's]] [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[Intentions]] branch.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
The seedy and suspicious Twi'lek had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin, graying features, and a wrinkled face. His hands appeared tired as they hovered endlessly over computers and [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]]. Con'varra had an unfailing loyality to Omze'kehr, often updating him on documents requested by spacers and tarnishing them at his ask.<ref name="PSG" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|His office is kept securely locked during the rare hours when he's not hunched over a datapad and computer screen forging datawork for a spacer.|Platt Okeefe on Con'varra in a datafile|<ref name="PSG" />}}
Dexterous skills possessed by Con'varra included [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] proficiency, dodging, and pickpocketing. The Twi'lek was knowledgeable on [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and [[Language/Legends|languages]] alongside concepts of a government nature, such as bureaucracy, [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law-enforcement]], and [[Star system/Legends|planetary systems]]. He also possessed streetwise and intimidation knowledge and had an understanding of business and value. As he was a Twi'lek, he could secretly use his<ref name="PSG" /> [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]]<ref name="TEGtAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> head-tails for communication.<ref name="PSG" />

Con'varra had mechanical and technical skill in security and computer programming and repair. When forging, the Twi'lek stayed delicate as he hunched himself over datapads and computers. He had a perceptive streak, evidenced by his skill in conning, searching, sneaking and hiding, [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]], investigation, and bargaining.<ref name="PSG" />

==Equipment==
Con'varra used a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] and a datapad. An immense computer with access to the BoSS databank assisted him in forgeries. The forger wore a one-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] silver [[Goggles/Legends|goggle]] with brown-straps and a monocle secured by his right [[Ear/Legends|ear]].<ref name="PSG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Con'varra was first mentioned in ''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]'', a [[1995]] [[West End Games]] roleplaying game book for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The book was authored by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and the color illustrations were done by [[Chris Gossett]].<ref name="PSG" /> Con'varra's name, spelt as "Con Varra," was used as an example name for Twi'leks in ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' published in [[2003]].<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>
